description: Phase II hard corpus — 12 bugs handpicked from II.1 prescreen + II.2 fix-locality analysis
methodology: Bugs selected for high canonical-file counts, real test failures (not timeout), and discriminating potential across C1/C2/C3 conditions. Ordering: Jsoup-87 first (marquee), then remaining Jsoup, then JacksonDatabind, then Closure.

bugs.fix_summary: HTML parser in case-preserving mode incorrectly allows link elements to nest inside other link elements; the tree builder state for <a> elements does not apply the standard HTML5 adoption agency algorithm in case-preserving mode
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Marquee discriminating bug: C1 prescreen 0/2 (both real test failures, not timeout). Does C2/C3 solve it where C1 fails? Four-class fix; case-preserving mode bypasses adoption agency algorithm.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: Cleaner.isValidBodyHtml produces wrong results for input that contains valid body HTML — the validation logic applies the whitelist check at the wrong structural level, flagging some valid elements as invalid
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: C1 prescreen 1/2 (one real fail). Three-class fix; whitelist check applied at wrong structural level.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: DocumentType node round-trips incorrectly because the output serializer omits the system identifier when the public identifier is present but the system identifier is empty string vs null; the distinction is not preserved through parse→serialize
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: C1 prescreen 2/2 pass. Richest fix-locality (5 canonical files spanning parser + node layers). Does C3 get more of the 5 files than C1?
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary:
CSS selector with :split-on-br pseudo-element does not correctly split text nodes on
boundaries because the pseudo-class evaluator does not account for the PseudoTextElement type introduced for inline text splitting
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: C1 prescreen 2/2. Three-class fix; new node type added without updating evaluators.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: Document.updateMetaCharsetElement() for XML mode fails to correctly set the charset declaration when no charset attribute exists — the method finds the xml declaration node but uses the wrong update path, leaving the declaration unchanged
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix; wrong update path for XML declaration charset. XML vs HTML mode distinction non-obvious.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: HTML entity unescaping produces wrong output for certain numeric character references and named entities because the entity trie lookup has incorrect handling for the boundary between decimal and hexadecimal references
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix; entity trie boundary bug only manifests for specific sequences. HTML5 tokenization spec required.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: Element.siblingElements() includes the element itself in the returned sibling list; the sibling traversal incorrectly includes the element being queried because the self-exclusion check compares by position rather than identity
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix; position-based vs identity-based comparison is subtle. Good locality discriminator.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.7 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: ObjectIdGenerator with ALWAYS_AS_REFERENCE_FIRST policy fails when the first reference comes before the definition in the JSON stream — the id resolver does not defer the reference lookup and instead throws UnresolvedForwardReference too early
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix in object-id subsystem; UnresolvedForwardReference looks like ordering problem but root cause is ALWAYS_AS_REFERENCE_FIRST annotation handling.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.6 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: Type refinement for Map types does not correctly handle the case where a declared Map subtype is narrowed via @JsonDeserialize(as=), causing the refined type to be ignored and the wrong deserializer to be selected
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: C1 prescreen 1/2 timeout. Two-class fix; type refinement vs coercion distinction is subtle. 900s timeout should reduce confound.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target from 1.6 to 1.8 in maven-build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: InlineVariables incorrectly inlines a variable across a closure boundary when the variable's value depends on the 'arguments' object, which is function-scoped and can be modified by an inner function
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix; incorrect inline only manifests when arguments escapes closure boundary. Requires understanding alias analysis failure mode.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target in build.xml and lib/rhino/build.properties; bump ant.build.javac.* properties in build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: MakeDeclaredNamesUnique ContextualRenameInverter extends the wrong callback interface (ScopedCallback instead of AbstractPostOrderCallback), causing it to be invoked at scope entry/exit in addition to node visits, which corrupts the rename-inversion state machine
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: Three-class fix; wrong callback interface causes state corruption only under inversion, not forward pass. Subtle invariant.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target in build.xml and lib/rhino/build.properties; bump ant.build.javac.* properties in build.xml

bugs.fix_summary: ScopedAliases transformation fails to handle hoisted function declarations inside goog.scope blocks, producing a wrong-scope binding when function declarations are lifted above their alias context
bugs.ttd_suited_rationale: C1 prescreen 1/2 timeout. Two-class fix; hoisting interaction with scope transformation only manifests for declarations, not expressions. 900s timeout reduces confound.
bugs.build_fix: bump source/target in build.xml and lib/rhino/build.properties; bump ant.build.javac.* properties in build.xml
